nodes.description: Public uint256 cap on the total number of Alpha Pass tokens that can ever be minted; writable by the owner via setMaxSupply.
Public uint256 mint price in wei per token; used in the payment check and writable by the owner via setCurrentPrice.
Public string prefix concatenated with the token id to build the metadata URI; writable by the owner via setBaseUri.
Mapping(uint256=>bool) tracking which Whale token ids have already been used to mint an Alpha Pass.
Running counter of Alpha Pass tokens minted so far, compared against maxSupply.
Hard-coded ERC721Enumerable contract (0xA871...4E88) queried for caller balances and token ids.
Public collection name string, initialized to 'Alpha Pass'.
Public collection symbol string, initialized to 'AP'.
External payable mint function; validates payment and supply, reads the caller's Whale balance, loops over owned Whale tokens and mints one Alpha Pass per unused Whale token.
Public view override returning baseURI concatenated with the decimal token id for existing tokens.
Public view that forwards to WhaleContract.totalSupply().
onlyOwner external setter that overwrites the baseURI metadata prefix.
onlyOwner external setter that overwrites the mint price.
onlyOwner external setter that overwrites the maximum supply cap.
Constructor initializing the ERC1155 URI 'https://game.example/api/item/{id}.json'.
Caller-controlled address; used as the balance/ownership lookup key in mint and as the owner check subject in onlyOwner functions.
Caller-supplied uint256 number of Alpha Pass tokens requested in mint.
Caller-supplied uint256 token id queried through uri().
Owner-supplied string that becomes the new baseURI.
Owner-supplied uint256 that becomes the new price.
Owner-supplied uint256 that becomes the new maxSupply.
Local cache of the caller's Whale NFT balance returned by WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender).
Local counter of how many Alpha Passes have been minted in the current call, used to stop at amount.
Loop index iterating over the caller's Whale tokens.
Local Whale token id obtained via WhaleContract.tokenOfOwnerByIndex(msg.sender, i).
Arithmetic expression price * amount used in the 'NOT_ENOUGH_PAID' check.
Arithmetic expression totalMinted + amount compared against maxSupply.
External calls into the fixed WhaleContract (balanceOf / tokenOfOwnerByIndex) performed before mint state is finalized.
_mint triggers _doSafeTransferAcceptanceCheck, which invokes IERC1155Receiver.onERC1155Received on the caller when it is a contract.

edges.reason: msg.sender is consumed by mint to read the caller's Whale balance and to receive minted tokens.
mint evaluates price * amount inside the payment requirement.
price state variable is an operand of the multiplication.
amount parameter is an operand of the multiplication.
mint evaluates totalMinted + amount inside the supply requirement.
totalMinted state variable is an operand of the addition.
amount parameter is an operand of the addition.
maxSupply bounds the totalMinted + amount arithmetic check.
mint performs external calls into WhaleContract before finishing its own accounting.
WhaleContract state variable is the target of the external call.
untrusted msg.sender is the argument passed into the external WhaleContract queries.
mint calls _mint, which performs the ERC1155 receiver acceptance callback on the recipient.
mintedTokens[wTokenId] is written only after the _mint acceptance callback returns.
totalMinted is incremented only after the _mint acceptance callback returns.
A malicious ERC1155 receiver can reenter mint from onERC1155Received before mintedTokens and totalMinted are updated.
mint reads mintedTokens[wTokenId] to skip Whale tokens already redeemed.
mint writes mintedTokens[wTokenId] = true after minting.
mint increments the totalMinted supply counter.
The result of WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender) is stored in the wBalance local.
mint initializes the local minted counter used to stop the loop.
mint drives the loop index i over the caller's Whale tokens.
wTokenId holds the Whale token id fetched during each loop iteration.
uri concatenates baseURI with the stringified token id.
uri requires mintedTokens[tokenId] to be true before returning metadata.
tokenId parameter selects which token metadata is returned and is checked against mintedTokens.
newUri parameter is the value assigned to baseURI.
setBaseUri overwrites the baseURI state variable.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() before allowing setBaseUri.
newPrice parameter is the value assigned to price.
setCurrentPrice overwrites the price state variable.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() before allowing setCurrentPrice.
newSupply parameter is the value assigned to maxSupply.
setMaxSupply overwrites the maxSupply state variable.
onlyOwner compares owner() with _msgSender() before allowing setMaxSupply.
totalSupply forwards the call to the external WhaleContract.totalSupply().

normalization_plan.reason: amount is a mint-only parameter that drives the payment check, supply check, loop break and mint count; it has no independent meaning outside mint.
tokenId is only used inside uri to gate on mintedTokens and to build the metadata string.
newUri is a single-assignment setter parameter only meaningful for setBaseUri.
newPrice is a single-assignment setter parameter only meaningful for setCurrentPrice.
newSupply is a single-assignment setter parameter only meaningful for setMaxSupply.
wBalance is the raw return value of the external WhaleContract.balanceOf(msg.sender) call and should collapse into that external operation.
minted is a transient loop counter that only exists for the duration of mint and controls the break condition.
i is a trivial loop induction variable with no standalone semantic value.
wTokenId is a per-iteration temporary holding the Whale token id used to key mintedTokens and _mint.
